archive_member_inventory.canonicalization: UTF-8 json.dumps(archive_members, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) without trailing newline; sorted relative POSIX paths; fields path, size, sha256

license.acquisition: The archive's own license files, unchanged (MIT OR Apache-2.0). No addition.

scope: TempDir removal on drop and close() (src/dir/mod.rs): when std::fs::remove_dir_all fails with PermissionDenied, every directory below the temporary directory gets its owner's rwx permissions and the removal is retried once; on Linux the walk never follows a link (O_PATH | O_NOFOLLOW opens checked by fstat, the mode changed on that inode through /proc/self/fd, descent through O_DIRECTORY | O_NOFOLLOW descriptors checked to be the same inode), elsewhere by path without following a link at the last component. bazel-rs seals its repository store's trees (no write bits on files and directories, docs/REPOSITORY_SLOTS.md "Sealed trees"), and a temporary directory holding a store (every test workspace's cache) must still be removed. No other behaviour, API, dependency version or feature change. All published archive files preserved; nothing added.
